records.name: Drone attack on Gorizont oil depot tank farm in Kambarskiy
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 27, photos attached) gives the coordinates of the attacked tank farm of the federal state institution Combine "Gorizont" of the state reserve (56.4284N 53.9096E, camera position 56.4766N 53.8216E); the General Staff statement of July 28 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the Rosreserve combine "Prioritet" in the settlement of Borok, Udmurtia, on July 27, with a fire on site, a closed-type facility serving as a major state oil depot more than 1,300 km from the border. Astra (July 27, video and photo attached) says the combine "Prioritet" was formerly known as "Gorizont" and stands in Borok, Kambarsky district, so the two names are one facility.

records.name: Drone attack on 3PL logistics warehouse in Koledino
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. records.name: Tire fire at ChRZ plant in Chekhov
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (July 28) quotes the governor that a drone hit an apartment block on Zemskaya Street in Chekhov during the overnight and morning attack on the capital region; the tire fire at the ChRZ plant comes from the sources of the original entry and no source ties it to a Ukrainian unit; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

records.name: Drone attack on LUKOIL-Permnefteorgsintez refinery, AVT-5 unit hit
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 29, videos and photo attached) shows the attack and a burning AVT-5 after "an effective hit"; the General Staff statement of July 30 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the refinery on July 29, a hit with a fire on site, about 13 million tonnes a year; the SBU weekly report of Aug 3 repeats the fire on the primary oil processing unit.

fix.note: Drones attack the "LUKOIL-Permnefteorgsintez" refinery. The AVT-5 unit was hit. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + USF - the SBU statement of July 29 (card attached) claims the strike on the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez refinery, more than 1,500 km from the border, and the USF commander's post of Aug 2 (t.me/robert_magyar/2690) credits it to the Birds of the 1st Separate Center of the USF, dating it July 30 where the SBU and the General Staff say July 29. Both claims are kept; the SBU, with the formal statement, stays primary.

records.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Ryazan
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 29, videos and photos attached) relays local footage of a fire at the Wildberries logistics centre in Ryazan (54.6755N 39.5746E) and shows FP-1 drones in pairs over Ryazan that morning, and Astra's OSINT analysis (July 29, video attached) confirms the fire; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) puts the hub at 54.6789N 39.5710E, about 173,000 sq m in the "Ryazansky" industrial park, with a partial collapse of structures recorded.

fix.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander (Madyar) lists Ryazan among the Wildberries hubs hit in his Telegram post of July 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2676). No formal claim naming a specific unit. Confidence: medium. This replaces the earlier entries based on Zelensky's confirmation of a Defense Forces operation and on the analyst's Wildberries rule.

records.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet at Sven-Transportna
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (July 29, claim post attached) says its network struck several objects on the way to the mobile launch sites of Shahed-type drones in Bryansk Oblast, among them a modernized relay cabinet burned at a station node, a diesel locomotive that forms the freight trains carrying the drones disabled, and the equipment of a communications tower that carries EW systems destroyed; the post does not say where each object stood (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

records.name: LSR partisans destroy communication tower equipment in Yurovo
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (July 29, claim post attached) says its network struck several objects on the way to the mobile launch sites of Shahed-type drones in Bryansk Oblast, among them the equipment of a communications tower that carries EW systems; the post does not say where each object stood or how the equipment was destroyed (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

records.name: LSR partisans disable diesel locomotive in Bryansk
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (July 29, claim post attached) says its network fully disabled a diesel locomotive that forms the freight trains carrying drones in Bryansk Oblast; the post does not say how it was disabled or where (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

records.name: SOF and Chernaya Iskra drone attack on Ryazan refinery
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of July 29 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units, in cooperation with Chernaya Iskra, hit the Ryazan refinery, a top-five Russian plant with 17-18 million tonnes a year, after the previous strike in May 2026; Chernaya Iskra (July 29, video attached) calls it the seventh refinery hit with its participation in 11 months; the General Staff statement of July 29 (card attached) records a hit with a fire on site; Exilenova+ (July 29, videos attached) shows the refinery and the Wildberries hub hit in the same attack, and its videos of FP-1 drones in pairs over Ryazan that morning are attached to both Ryazan records because the posts do not say which target each pair went for.

records.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Mastinovka, Penza Oblast
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 30, videos and photo attached) says Penza was under attack and a Wildberries warehouse was presumably the target; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) puts the hub at 53.2691N 44.7970E, about 180,000 sq m, among the newest of the network (handed over in autumn 2025), the first of the triple strike of that night on Penza, Sarapul and Perm.

records.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Sarapul
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 30, videos attached) shows the moment of one of the hits and says "Liutyi, FP's brother" worked on the warehouses that day, and Astra (July 30, videos attached) posted the drone attack footage and the burning warehouse; Dnipro Osint (July 30, photo attached) says the fire area grew and the warehouse has 75,000 sq m, while Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) gives about 53,000 sq m at 56.4779N 53.6946E; the hub serves the Volga Federal District.

records.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Zamulyanka, Perm Krai
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) puts the Perm hub at 57.9095N 56.2558E, about 50,000 sq m, about 1,400 km from the border, the deepest strike on the Wildberries network of the campaign and the one that brought the count of attacked hubs to 14; the sources of the record (DW, Pravda, thepage.ua) carry no footage. Koledino, Voronezh, Tver and Perm do not appear in the USF commander's posts of July 18-Aug 2 that were checked, so the USF attribution here rests on the analyst's Wildberries rule alone.

records.name: Drones hit Tamanneftegaz oil terminal, at least two tank farms burn
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 30, videos and photos attached) says the port of Taman was attacked and burning and shows a panorama of the port from Anapa; Dnipro Osint (July 30, poster card attached) records large fires on the Tamanneftegaz terminal, one of the key oil, oil-product and LPG transshipment points of the south; the SBU statement of July 31 (card attached) says SBU, together with the Defense Forces, hit the infrastructure of the Taman port with a large fire; the USF commander's post of Aug 2 says 12 tanks of 5,000 tonnes each were destroyed and the fire area exceeded 17,000 sq m.

records.name: Fire at military unit 51532 in Molkin destroys tent hangar
records.note: Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. records.name: Drone attack on Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery in Volgograd
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 31, video and photo attached) says the refinery's industrial zone was burning and, at 03:46, that a massive attack was under way with the refinery and the Wildberries hub among the confirmed targets; the General Staff statement of July 31 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the refinery, a hit with a fire on site, about 15 million tonnes a year, with the scale of damage being established.

fix.note: Drones attack the "Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka" refinery*. Fire on the premises of the enterprise. * The exact location of the impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF + SBU + GUR - the USF commander's post of Aug 2 (t.me/robert_magyar/2690) credits the strike on the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery to the 1st Separate Center and the 414th Brigade of the USF jointly with the SBU and GUR, and the SBU statement of July 31 (card attached) says the SBU hit it together with the Defense Forces. This replaces the earlier GUR primary, for which no first-party claim was found.

records.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Volgograd
records.note: Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 31, videos and photo attached) shows the moment of the drone attack on the Wildberries warehouses at night and the smoke over the city, and Astra's OSINT analysis (July 31, videos attached) confirms the warehouse burning and quotes the governor on five injured; Exilenova+ also says the Wildberries distribution centre in Volgograd, a logistics complex of 44,000 sq m that serves the Volgograd, Astrakhan and neighbouring regions, was among the first objects hit in the night attack.

fix.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander (Madyar) called the Volgograd hub his ninth Wildberries hit in his Telegram post of July 31 (t.me/robert_magyar/2681). No formal claim naming a specific unit. Confidence: medium.
